'''Hikawa Shrine''' may refer to:

* [[Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)]], the main Shinto shrine in Saitama Prefecture, which has several branch shrines, including:
''' [[Hikawa Shrine (Akasaka)]], in Akasaka, Minato, Tokyo
''' [[Hikawa Shrine (Kawagoe)]]

'''Hikawa Shrine''' (氷川神社) is a [[kami (Shinto)]] shrine dedicated to {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊}} as its primary deity. It is central to the {{ill|Hikawa Faith|ja|氷川信仰}}, with over 200 shrines bearing the Hikawa name, primarily located along the {{ill|Arakawa River (Kantō)|ja|荒川 (関東)}} in the former {{ill|Musashi Province|ja|武蔵国}}, which includes present-day {{ill|Saitama Prefecture|ja|埼玉県}} and {{ill|Tokyo|ja|東京都}}. Including shrines without the Hikawa name, there are over 260 associated shrines, some of which are written as "簸川神社."
